item.title: Regional International Accounting Research Forum on China (RIARF - China)
item.content:encoded:
C.S. Agnes Cheng, University of Oklahoma

Siqi Li, Santa Clara University

Ling Lei Lisic, Virginia Tech

This forum invites high-quality accounting research with a country or region-specific focus for presentation and potential publication in the Journal of International Accounting Research. The 2027 edition concentrates on China and seeks to advance scholarship on accounting practices in regions that have been underrepresented in international accounting literature.

The forum welcomes theoretical, archival, experimental, case-based, survey, interview, and other rigorous research methodologies, including replication studies that offer new insights for international accounting research. Selected papers will receive peer review, developmental feedback from editors and reviewers, and expedited consideration for publication in JIAR.

Appel publié par Journal of International Accounting Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Financial and managerial accounting practices in China
  • Auditing and corporate governance in China
  • IFRS adoption and implementation in China
  • Taxation issues in China
  • ESG reporting in China

Timeline

  • March 1, 2027: Submission deadline
  • April 15, 2027: Decision date
  • June 19, 2027: Forum dates

Associate editors

  • Wang Dong, Zhejiang University
  • Nan Zhou, University of Cincinnati
